# Caritas Internationalis

> Global confederation of Catholic relief, development and social service organizations working to combat poverty, promote human dignity, and respond to humanitarian crises worldwide.

Caritas Internationalis operates through a network of 162 member organizations worldwide, guided by Catholic social teaching and the leadership of figures like Cardinal Óscar Rodríguez Maradiaga and Pope Francis. The organization addresses food security, human trafficking, refugee support, climate change, and emergency disaster response through faith-based humanitarian action.

## Key Topics

- Humanitarian aid and emergency response
- Food security and right to nutrition
- One Human Family campaign (Una sola familia humana)
- Climate change and environmental responsibility
- Human trafficking prevention
- Refugee and migrant support
- Poverty eradication
- Catholic social teaching
- SPHERE humanitarian standards
- Spiritual and ethical dimensions of development
- Disaster relief and recovery
- Latin American social pastoral work
- Global prayer campaigns
- Human rights advocacy

## Emergency Response and Humanitarian Aid

- [Chile rises from the rubble](https://www.caritas.org/chile-rises-from-the-rubble): Caritas responds to 8.8 magnitude earthquake near Concepción, Chile
- [Caritas Turkey supporting Syrian refugees](https://www.caritas.org/caritas-turkey-supporting-syrian-refugees): Caritas Turkey provides emergency winter relief to Syrian refugees
- [As the crisis in Greece worsens, Caritas helps Athens' immigrants](https://www.caritas.org/as-the-crisis-in-greece-worsens-caritas-helps-athens-immigrants): Caritas Greece serves 300 daily meals to Athens refugees amid crisis
- [Being a better humanitarian](https://www.caritas.org/being-a-better-humanitarian): Jorge Nuño Mayer discusses SPHERE standards for humanitarian quality

## Global Campaigns and Advocacy

- [Caritas va a lanzar una ola mundial de oraciones para terminar con la pobreza](https://www.caritas.org/caritas-va-lanzar-una-ola-mundial-de-oraciones-para-terminar-con-la-pobreza): Caritas launches global prayer wave campaign against poverty on Dec 10
- [Fight Trafficking: What to do in the European Union?](https://www.caritas.org/combatir-la-trata-de-personas-que-hacer-en-la-union-europea): Caritas advocates for EU action against human trafficking in Paris

## Spiritual Guidance and Catholic Social Teaching

- [Spiritual and ethical dimensions in dealing with climate change](https://www.caritas.org/spiritual-and-ethical-dimensions-in-dealing-with-climate-change): Fr Patricio Sarlat reflects on religious response to climate change
- [Message of His Holiness Benedict XVI for Lent 2013](https://www.caritas.org/message-of-his-holiness-benedict-xvi-for-lent-2013): Pope Benedict XVI's Lent 2013 message on faith and charity

## Recognition and Awards

- [Caritas Portugal wins human rights award](https://www.caritas.org/caritas-portugal-wins-human-rights-award): Portuguese Parliament honors Caritas Portugal with Human Rights Award
